title: Confluent Cloud RBAC inventory export
description: Canonical input contract for rbac-analyzer. Documentation only: the analyzer validates with its own standard-library code and does not load this file.

exportedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the export, e.g. 2026-11-04T12:00:00Z. Missing value produces a warning.

completeInventory.description: true when every role binding of the organization is present. Missing value is treated as false with a warning.

bindingIdsAreConfluentBindingIds.description: true when each row id is the id of one distinct Confluent role-binding object. Only then are exact duplicates classified SAFE.

id.description: Unique per record. Missing ids are synthesized as row-<index>; duplicated ids make every affected record INVALID.

resource.description: Absent or null for bindings without a resource (for example OrganizationAdmin).

type.description: ORGANIZATION, ENVIRONMENT or KAFKA_CLUSTER are analyzed; other values are preserved and reported as UNSUPPORTED.

environmentId.description: Required for ENVIRONMENT and KAFKA_CLUSTER; must be absent for ORGANIZATION.

clusterId.description: Required for KAFKA_CLUSTER; must be absent for ORGANIZATION and ENVIRONMENT.

crn.description: Optional. Kept as evidence; one structured scope must not appear with two different CRNs.

type.description: Topic, Group, TransactionalId or any other Confluent resource type (opaque).

name.description: Must be non-empty for LITERAL. An empty PREFIXED name is UNSUPPORTED.

patternType.description: LITERAL or PREFIXED are analyzed; other values are UNSUPPORTED.
